about: StoneRoadMap kit textures, Direction B (Métal Hurlant necro-cathedral), generated by grace for Patch on 2026-11-12 and in use since that day. Each surface owns one pigment family: dark slate floor, oxblood trim, near-black ceiling. Z-Image base bf16 with the house LoRA rrink_zimage_v5_seg6_3000 at 1.0, seamless, 25 steps res_multistep cfg 4 shift 3, 1024x1024, on den-m5 and den-nimo; normals by authoring/tools/textures/make_tileable.py at strength 3. Each entry names its seed; the other seeds and the concept references are in authoring/assets/textures/stoneroad-direction-b/ (its sources.json and README.md). Since the wall stones (2026-11-12) the walls are built of real stones, which take stone-surface-36, a plain stone surface; the pack's painted ashlar wall-ashlar-slate stays in authoring/assets/textures/stoneroad-direction-b/.
